info.name: Online Booking Management System API
info.description:
Postman collection covering all REST API endpoints of the Online Booking Management System (Spring Boot backend). Includes success, validation-failure, duplicate, not-found, and conflict test cases as required by the project SOP's testing procedure. Organized into folders: Health, Auth, Users, Services, Bookings.

Run order matters within each folder (top to bottom) since later requests depend on IDs and tokens captured by earlier ones via collection variables.

KNOWN ISSUES surfaced by this collection (see 'Register - Self-Assign ADMIN Role (Security Check)' request in Users folder): the current backend does not restrict the 'role' field on public registration, allowing privilege escalation. This is intentionally included as a regression check — it currently returns 201/ADMIN, which is the WRONG outcome and should be fixed.

request.description: INTENTIONAL REGRESSION TEST, not a feature test. A public, unauthenticated request should NEVER be able to set its own role to ADMIN. This request currently succeeds (201, role=ADMIN), which confirms a privilege-escalation vulnerability in UserServiceImpl.registerUser(). Used here only to obtain an admin token for the rest of this collection until the bug is fixed. Once fixed, this request should return 400/403, and the collection's admin-only requests below should instead use a pre-seeded or manually-promoted admin account.
